description: Takes the netboot.xyz ISO out of a machine reinstalled with the netboot image, live, once the OS is installed: the machine then boots from its disk only. The machine has no UEFI, so the OS must have a BIOS boot loader. Getting the ISO back means reinstalling with netboot, which wipes the disk. On a machine without the ISO it succeeds and changes nothing. Scope: vms.action.

vm.description: Machine id, as returned by list_vms or create_vm.

name: eject_netboot_iso
title: Remove the netboot.xyz ISO
